title: E-waste battery safety: hierarchical CNN with adaptive fuzzy temporal supervisory risk model (code, trained models and results)
description: Code, trained checkpoints, experiment scripts and result tables for a simulation study of pre-shred lithium-ion battery fire prevention: two-stage EfficientNet-B0 battery detection, Mamdani fuzzy risk, corroboration-gated adaptive temporal memory, CNN-confidence fusion and a latching supervisory state machine. All sensor data are simulated; image datasets are public and must be downloaded separately (see docs/DATA.md). Includes a moving-belt line simulation with a tiered diverter, robustness checks of every hand-set setting and of the gas and thermal models, and tests on outside images (Wikimedia Commons, BatSort, XBAT+, ZeroWaste).
